title.en: A Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel map of the printed concrete pump delivery pipe line
title.zh: 用《Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel》给已印的concrete pump delivery pipe画一张目录

description.en: concrete pump delivery pipe is restated under Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel. The Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe is a straight spare made by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The page prints red enamel and reinforced coupling or flange ends. It does not print wall thickness, a fixed diameter table, a length table, or a list price. Inner diameter is copied only from a pump page that has the cell.
description.zh: concrete pump delivery pipe放在《Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel》的结构下重述。混凝土泵输送管是河北品锦机械在邢台制造的直管配件。页面写明红色涂层和加强快接或法兰端。没有壁厚、固定管径表、长度表，也没有公开标价。内径只从印了这一格的泵页抄。

h1.en: The printed concrete pump delivery pipe line, ordered as Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel orders its page
h1.zh: 已印的concrete pump delivery pipe，按《Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel》的页面次序来写

directAnswer.en: Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel is an encyclopedia page. concrete pump delivery pipe remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. The Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe is a straight spare made by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The page prints red enamel and reinforced coupling or flange ends. It does not print wall thickness, a fixed diameter table, a length table, or a list price. Inner diameter is copied only from a pump page that has the cell.
directAnswer.zh: 《Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel》是百科页。concrete pump delivery pipe仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 混凝土泵输送管是河北品锦机械在邢台制造的直管配件。页面写明红色涂层和加强快接或法兰端。没有壁厚、固定管径表、长度表，也没有公开标价。内径只从印了这一格的泵页抄。

body.en: “History” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. The spare is a straight high-pressure delivery pipe for Pinjin trailer and mixer pumps. Factory photos show red enamel, reinforced coupling ends and an identification label. End connection is described as a reinforced coupling or flange. Finish is factory red enamel. Diameter and length are quoted after the pump model is named. Wall thickness is absent. Service life is absent. Six pages print a delivery-pipe inner diameter. Electric 20 prints 80 mm. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm, with a dash. Integrated Mixer Pump, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 each print 100 / 125 mm, with a slash. Those four slash cells are not the same pump. The other published pump pages have no delivery-pipe diameter cell, so their DN is a missing field. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “历史”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 这件配件是品锦拖泵和搅拌泵用的直管。工厂照片是红色涂层、加强快接端和识别标签。端部写成加强快接或法兰。表面是工厂红色涂层。管径和长度要在写出泵型号之后报价。壁厚没有。使用寿命没有。 六台泵印了输送管内径。电动20是 80 mm。电动15是 100–125 mm，用连接号。搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 各印 100 / 125 mm，用斜线。斜线相同的四台不是同一台泵。其余已公布泵页没有输送管内径这一格，管径是缺字段。 标题到此为止。

heading.zh: 运行, 维护, 与法规

body.en: “Operations, maintenance, and regulations” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Include the pump model slug, the inner diameter copied from that model's cell when the cell exists, the length, and the quantity. If the model page has no diameter cell, say so and leave DN blank rather than borrowing 80 mm or 100 / 125 mm from another model. The Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe is a straight spare made by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The page prints red enamel and reinforced coupling or flange ends. It does not print wall thickness, a fixed diameter table, a length table, or a list price. Inner diameter is copied only from a pump page that has the cell. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “运行, 维护, 与法规”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写上泵的目录型号。 该型号若印了内径，按那一格原文抄。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Tourism” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. No. There is no fixed size table. 100 / 125 mm and 100–125 mm appear only on the six pump pages named above. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “来源章节：Tourism”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 再写长度和数量。型号页没有管径格时，写明缺这一格，不要从别的型号借 80 mm 或 100 / 125 mm。 混凝土泵输送管是河北品锦机械在邢台制造的直管配件。页面写明红色涂层和加强快接或法兰端。没有壁厚、固定管径表、长度表，也没有公开标价。内径只从印了这一格的泵页抄。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Dimensions”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. No. Wall thickness is a missing field. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“尺寸”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 没有。没有固定尺寸表。100 / 125 mm 和 100–125 mm 只出现在上面点名的六台泵页面。 没有。壁厚是缺字段。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Incidents”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. Email or WhatsApp on the contact page, to Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Stop when the printed fragment stops. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chesapeake_Bay_Bridge%E2%80%93Tunnel
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Incidents”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 通过联系页的邮件或 WhatsApp，发给邢台河北品锦机械。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chesapeake_Bay_Bridge%E2%80%93Tunnel

question.en: Why is Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel not a source of extra ratings for concrete pump delivery pipe?
question.zh: 为什么《Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel》不能给concrete pump delivery pipe增加额定值？

answer.en: No. There is no fixed size table. 100 / 125 mm and 100–125 mm appear only on the six pump pages named above. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 没有。没有固定尺寸表。100 / 125 mm 和 100–125 mm 只出现在上面点名的六台泵页面。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Can the outline heading “Incidents” rename concrete pump delivery pipe?
question.zh: 大纲标题“来源章节：Incidents”可以改掉concrete pump delivery pipe的名称吗？

answer.en: No. Wall thickness is a missing field. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 没有。壁厚是缺字段。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Does “History” on Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel fill a blank on the concrete pump delivery pipe row?
question.zh: 《Chesapeake Bay Bridge–Tunnel》上的“历史”会填上concrete pump delivery pipe的空白格子吗？

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
